allowed: accepted repository source, tests, SSOT records, and acceptance evidence
GitHub main ref delivery after the A5 decision commit
prohibited: live external literature retrieval or open-status confirmation
calibration quality, accuracy, recall, statistical performance, or generalization
production, deployed-service, device, or monitoring evidence
public communication of any research conclusion

release_decision.reason: Q1 was invalidated when R1 was reopened for its missing durable independent AI review reports. Historical source-delivery evidence is retained, but no current GitHub source delivery decision is authorized until R1 and Q1 are reaccepted.

delivery_requirements.remote_ref_readback: git ls-remote origin refs/heads/main must equal the final local HEAD after push

acceptance_record.accepted_by: 用户（研究负责人和仓库所有者）
acceptance_record.authority_basis: 用户已明确要求验收通过、持续完成，并在每个阶段提交并推送到 GitHub；本切片仅记录受限的仓库源级发布决定。

invalidation.basis: R1 合同版本 4 使两份持久化独立 AI PASS 报告成为阻断条件，当前 Q1 已随之失效，因此 A5 的历史发布决定不得继续作为当前 GitHub 源码交付授权。
invalidation.required_reacceptance: 先接受 R1，再重新核验或版本化 Q1，并在新的上游身份上重新执行 A5 的机器、人工与发布复审。

unverified_items: Calibration quality, accuracy, recall, statistical performance, or generalization
Production, deployed-service, device, or monitoring behavior
Public communication of any research conclusion
